prompt:
Create a complete 1440 × 900 desktop portfolio homepage for John Paul Fernandez, rendered edge to edge with no browser frame. Potential clients and collaborators should quickly understand his real profile, skill range, and product-building approach. Use the supplied portrait reference and preserve John’s identity.

This is an additional composition in the chosen Cutaway Folio world, guided by the original architectural cutaway comp. Keep its connected sectional drawing, cobalt/coral/acid-yellow/chalk/graphite planes, precise drafting marks, and expressive editorial type. Give this version more breathing room: use a wide chalk profile field on the left with the name, role, concise positioning line, real paragraph, and “See my work” in a clear vertical reading order. Let the portrait bridge into a clean, three-tier cutaway on the right, with Interfaces, Applications, and Backend systems as broad stepped planes. Keep each real technology label readable, with restrained construction lines and no decorative architectural details that obscure content. A quiet Selected projects strip begins at the bottom. This should still feel vivid and authored, but read as a functioning developer portfolio rather than an architecture poster.

Use the exact real text: “John Paul Fernandez”, “Full Stack Developer”, “Fast, clear, dependable web products”, “I like building web products that feel fast, clear, and dependable. Most of my work lives at the intersection of React interfaces, Next.js apps, and backend systems that are simple to scale and maintain.”, “3+ years building web products”, “Interfaces”, “Applications”, “Backend systems”, “Selected projects”, “Project writeups are not published yet”. Include only React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Git, Firebase, Nginx; navigation About, Work, Experience, Contact. No invented claims, projects, logos, employers, or testimonials.
edit_prompt: Edit the supplied portfolio composition image. Preserve the 1440 × 900 page, the real portrait and identity, the exact profile copy and technology labels, the warm chalk background, cobalt/coral/acid-yellow/graphite cutaway tiers, typography, and composition. Keep the portrait bridging the left profile field and right-side stacked capability planes. The edit is specifically to remove the small browser-style wireframe with an image placeholder in the upper-right Interfaces tier. Replace only that placeholder with quiet uninterrupted cobalt plane and a few restrained drafting rules that belong to the section drawing. Do not add a project screenshot, website thumbnail, product mockup, new copy, logo, interface card, company, client, or claim. Keep all real content legible and leave every other element unchanged.
copyDirection: Short, natural, factual language for hiring teams: direct and results-minded, without inflated professional phrasing.
